Definition: a suburb (i.e. open country whither flocks are driven from pasture); hence, the area around a building, or the margin of the sea
BiblicalUsage: The Levites dwelt in Gilead and in all the suburbs of Sharon, and the Levites left their suburbs and their possession and came to Judah and Jerusalem when Jeroboam cast them off. The word is the suburb itself, the open pastureland around the Levitical cities, and it marks the land the Levites lived on.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the suburbs of the Levites show what God gave His servants: no inheritance of land, but pastureland around the cities, and a portion among His people.
